title: Intermediate MEC / CEC with CLAT Integration
tagline: Structured CLAT coaching for students aiming at National Law Universities.
overview: This programme is designed for students pursuing Intermediate MEC/CEC who want to build a strong foundation in Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, and Business Studies while preparing simultaneously for the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT). The integrated curriculum combines Intermediate academics with structured CLAT preparation, helping students develop skills in English, Current Affairs, Legal Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Techniques.
eligibility: Class 10 pass required. CLAT-UG has no upper age limit.
board: Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh

sections.heading: What is CLAT?
paragraphs: The Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) is the national-level entrance examination conducted by the Consortium of National Law Universities for admission to the five-year integrated LL.B. programmes (B.A. LL.B., B.B.A. LL.B., B.Com. LL.B., etc.) at the National Law Universities (NLUs), and to LL.M. programmes. It is held once a year, in December, in offline pen-and-paper mode. Confirm dates at consortiumofnlus.ac.in.

sections.heading: CLAT Course Structure & Examination Pattern
paragraphs: 120 multiple-choice questions, 2 hours, 1 mark each; −0.25 for every wrong answer. All questions are passage-based, with the difficulty pegged at Class 12 level.
items: Current Affairs including General Knowledge — 28–32 questions (about 25%)

sections.heading: NLUs and law schools reached through CLAT
paragraphs: NLSIU Bengaluru; NALSAR Hyderabad; NLIU Bhopal; WBNUJS Kolkata; NLU Jodhpur; HNLU Raipur; GNLU Gandhinagar; RMLNLU Lucknow; RGNUL Patiala; CNLU Patna; NUALS Kochi; NLUO Cuttack; NUSRL Ranchi; NLUJA Assam; DSNLU Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh's own NLU); TNNLU Tiruchirappalli; MNLU Mumbai, Nagpur and Aurangabad; HPNLU Shimla; DNLU Jabalpur; DBRANLU Sonipat; and others.

Over 60 private and affiliated law colleges also accept CLAT scores. NLU Delhi conducts its own exam, AILET, whose preparation overlaps almost entirely with CLAT. The same preparation covers SLAT, LSAT-India, MH-CET Law and AP LAWCET.

sections.heading: MEC or CEC for CLAT?
paragraphs: Both are accepted. CEC (Civics, Economics, Commerce) gives direct exposure to political science and constitutional concepts that feed the Legal Reasoning and GK sections; MEC keeps the CA/IPMAT doors open while still preparing for CLAT. Our counsellors help students choose based on aptitude and back-up plans.

sections.heading: Specializations
paragraphs: CLAT/AILET focus; AP LAWCET focus; Law + Commerce (B.B.A. LL.B. / B.Com. LL.B. orientation).

sections.heading: Admission requirements
items: Transfer certificate, study certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar, passport-size photographs
